name: forge-mcp
description: Forge - Agent Reputation Protocol. Portable reputation for AI agents. MCP-native identity, vouching, trust scores that follow agents across platforms.

tools.name: forge_register
tools.description: Register an agent on the Forge network with a unique ID and capabilities manifest

tools.name: forge_vouch
tools.description: Vouch for another agent reputation - endorse their trustworthiness in a specific context

tools.name: forge_verify
tools.description: Verify an agent identity and reputation credentials

tools.name: forge_endorse
tools.description: Endorse an agent proficiency in a specific skill or domain

tools.name: forge_reputation
tools.description: Query an agent trust score and reputation history

tools.name: forge_store
tools.description: Store persistent knowledge for an agent (key-value pairs in namespaces)

tools.name: forge_recall
tools.description: Retrieve stored knowledge by key and namespace
